title: PEEBLES_NONEQUILIBRIUM_RECOMBINATION_APPEAL
recombination_model: Peebles (1968) effective-three-level atom; H-only; implemented with textbook-corrected Boltzmann factor exp(-13.6 eV / kT) in beta_eff (DEPARTURE from precommit text which specified exp(-3.4 eV / kT); precommit-exact form produces no recombination)
drag_epoch_model: baryon-drag optical depth integral with the same buggy 1/(a^2 * H) integrand as precommit-specified
bbn_model: schematic Wagoner two-state weak freeze-out (identical to CR001@19)

precommit_bugs_identified.Bug_A: Precommit Peebles RHS uses exp(-3.4 eV / kT) in beta_2; standard Peebles requires multiplying by an additional exp(-h*nu_alpha / kT) factor (Lyman-alpha 10.2 eV) on the ionization term, combining to exp(-13.6 eV / kT). Without this, equilibrium is Saha-n=2 which sits at x_e ~ 1 forever (no recombination). Runner DEPARTED from precommit and used the textbook-correct form.
precommit_bugs_identified.Bug_B: Precommit tau integrand has 1/(a^2 * H); standard derivation from tau = integral(n_e sigma_T c dt) with dt = da/(a*H) gives 1/(a * H). Runner HONORED the precommit specification per the appeal discipline, producing the FAIL documented in P1, P2, P3.

P1.name: Acoustic angular scale 100*theta_* within 5% of Planck

P2.name: Acoustic peak multipole ell_A within 5% of Planck

P3.name: Drag sound horizon r_d within 5% of Planck

verdict_reason: All three gates fail by 12-29x the threshold. Root cause identified as Bug B in the precommit-specified tau integrand. Substrate identities not implicated.
retest_plan: CR001c@19 will correct both Bug A (in the precommit text) and Bug B (in the precommit text and runner). Same substrate, same gates.
